summary:
Scope: the state of Claude usage measurement on the fdev workspace under #4638 after Root's 2026-11-01 decision (recorded at #4730, decision 2): telemetry is forward-only, with no backward compatibility and no old data needed; continuous capture of new Claude sessions is approved as a timer with a daily cap; the deferred backlog waves for live-agent transcripts are dropped; historical reconciliation and the off-machine backup pull are no longer needed and were closed as not planned. This supersedes the earlier version that recorded continuous capture as declined. It is a recorded decision boundary, not current authority or live state; refresh from the receiver and the issue before action.

What exists: a published Host that receives Claude transcript provenance; a closed-transcript backlog captured by hand in bounded waves and accepted; and a user timer that captures new and grown transcripts through the same producer association and capture state, with the drain timer still draining the queue (design and limits in github/telemetry-continuous-capture-reuses-existing-state).

Explicit limits and Unknowns: coverage is per response, not per dispatch, so attribution to dispatches stays Unknown. Forward-only means transcripts that were closed and uncaptured when the timer was baselined are not counted. A file that was live at the baseline is captured whole from its start the next time it grows. The reader skips responses after a malformed row until the next prompt (github/claude-transcript-capture-coverage-limits). The capture shares the 256-identity and 8-source limits with the one Codex source still active, so the selection is capped. A stop of the timer disables it until a person clears the marker, so a quiet timer is not proof of current coverage. The script and units are installed state on fdev only and are not in this repository, so source delivery and installed state are separate facts. Receiver-side expiry, disk-full behaviour and off-machine retention stay Unknown, and need not be settled for forward-only measurement. A shared-principal second association and a separate Claude principal were both declined in favour of the existing state. The parent outcome (qualified operational collection with explicit Unknown cases) is tracked in the roadmap.
title: fdev Claude telemetry is forward-only: timer capture of new and grown transcripts is approved; the backlog waves are dropped; remaining limits are explicit
